answer: Citation bond: each identity cites one verified contribution, and a falcon auditor traces the chain to a real task. A false citation sends a ripple through the ledger: work re-checked, the bond burns, the citer is flagged. Each posts a 40-credit bond; the k-th fake costs 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000 against a 40,000 pool. One work cannot back two identities; a tide of rented citations collapses onto one source. Honest agents pay 40 once.
